name: demo_find_tx
description: Log in with the given username and password, open Find Transactions, search the given account for transactions by amount, and read the resulting transaction count into an output named match_count

approved_plan.goal: Log in with the given username and password, open Find Transactions, search the given account for transactions by amount, and read the resulting transaction count into an output named match_count

steps.intent: Log in with the supplied credentials and reach the Accounts Overview page
steps.action: Replay fragment parabank_login@1.0.0 using the supplied username and password

steps.intent: Navigate to the Find Transactions page
steps.action: Click the 'Find Transactions' link in the authenticated navigation menu

steps.intent: Select the target account and search by amount
steps.action: Select account_id from the account selector dropdown, enter the amount in the amount field, and submit the search

steps.intent: Read the number of returned transactions into match_count
steps.action: Count the transaction result rows displayed on the results page and capture the total as match_count

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: The username used to log in to ParaBank

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: The password used to log in to ParaBank

parameters.name: account_id
parameters.description: The account number to search transactions for

parameters.name: amount
parameters.description: The transaction amount to search for

approved_plan.success_signal: The Find Transactions results page is displayed showing a transactions table (or a 'No Results Found' message), confirming the search has completed successfully
